decisions.reason: The source changes package and bundle price variation, not the independently itemized service-price breakdown, which already supports classification by property square footage.

The deferred calculator already assigns property square footage to pricing tiers and calculates itemized and bundle-qualified totals; the pricing-page display revision does not necessarily change that behavior.
Varying prices by square footage does not change the requirement that all pricing is one-time or the removal of monthly and annual tabs.
The pricing destination's contents may change, but the navigation requirement to link to detailed pricing remains valid without modification.
The gallery's browsing mode, tabs, and secondary content are unrelated to package pricing by square footage.
The pricing revision does not affect gallery hover-animation behavior.
The pricing-page revision does not alter the homepage design direction, image emphasis, or blue overlay settings.
Square-footage-based package pricing does not change the sitewide requirement for image-focused visual design.
The pricing revision does not affect the requirement to associate each listed service with a relevant image.
The requested package-pricing variation has no effect on the homepage gallery's basic animation.
